title: ScarletLink
question: Who needs to act next?
summary: ScarletLink was conceived to support donor matching and emergency response. This spread follows an illustrative handoff from a patient’s open request to a donor’s offer.

provenance.scope: Portfolio framing and proposed two-role study.
Project intent and documented patient and donor roles.
Subhasis Jena’s Firebase configuration update, 16 September 2025.
Application commit attributed to Shivanesh G. Full team credits remain pending.

figure.alt: A patient request marked open is followed by a donor offer.
figure.caption: A donor responds to an open request.
figure.source: Original CSS diagram created for this portfolio preview.

contribution.description: Subhasis updated ScarletLink’s Firebase app configuration.

scene.alt: Two views of demo request R–014 show a patient opening a request and a donor sending an offer.
scene.caption: The same fictional request appears first in the patient view and then in the donor view.
scene.source: Original CSS diagram created for this portfolio preview.

detail.alt: Request R–014 shows Offer sent as its status and Patient reviews offer as the next action.
detail.caption: The proposed detail names the next actor immediately below the status.
detail.source: Original CSS diagram created for this portfolio preview.

decision.title: Put the next action beside the status
decision.description: An offer tells the patient that someone responded. In this proposal, a second line names who acts next and what they do. Both views retain the request ID so a reader can follow the same request across the handoff.

caseStudy.limitation: The scene and detail use fictional records to demonstrate a proposed handoff. The project’s implemented workflow and how people used it still need to be verified.
